# package program

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/program"
```

Package program is the program download of CiA 302-3 on the device side: the objects through which a CANopen manager replaces the application software of a device over SDO.

  - 0x1F50 program data (ARRAY of DOMAIN, write-only): the program image, written with an SDO (block) download;
  - 0x1F51 program control (ARRAY of UNSIGNED8): writing 0 stops the program, 1 starts it, 2 resets it, 3 clears it (erases the flash); reading returns the program's state (0 stopped, 1 started, 3 cleared);
  - 0x1F56 application software identification (ARRAY of UNSIGNED32, read-only): a value identifying the program (a CRC, a version), which the manager compares with its expected value 0x1F55;
  - 0x1F57 flash status identification (ARRAY of UNSIGNED32, read-only): bit 0 set while programming is in progress, bits 1..7 an error code ([FlashError](#type-flasherror)).

The sub-index is the program number (1 for a device with one program). A [Device](#type-device) serves the objects of a dictionary and leaves the flashing to a [Handler](#type-handler). The sequence a manager uses (Lely lely-core's boot slave process; master.Master.DownloadProgram) is: stop (0x1F51 = 0), clear (0x1F51 = 3), download 0x1F50, poll 0x1F57 until bit 0 is clear and check the error code, start (0x1F51 = 1), poll 0x1F51 until it reads 1.

Sources: CiA 302-3 is a member document; the object meanings and values here follow Lely lely-core (src/co/nmt\_boot.c, which cites CiA 302-2 v4.1.0) and Zephyr's CANopenNode program download module (modules/canopennode/canopen\_program.c, which cites the CiA 302-3 draft standard proposal v4.1.0): the program control values, the flash status codes and the state rules (clear only when stopped, data only when cleared, control in Pre-operational only) are taken from them.

## Constants

```go
const (
	IndexData           uint16 = 0x1F50 // program data (device)
	IndexControl        uint16 = 0x1F51 // program control (device)
	IndexIdentification uint16 = 0x1F56 // application software identification (device)
	IndexFlashStatus    uint16 = 0x1F57 // flash status identification (device)
	// IndexExpectedIdentification is the manager's expected application
	// software identification of each node (ARRAY of UNSIGNED32,
	// sub-index = node-ID).
	IndexExpectedIdentification uint16 = 0x1F55
	// IndexManagerData is the manager's program data of each node (ARRAY
	// of DOMAIN, sub-index = node-ID), downloaded to the node's 0x1F50
	// sub-index 1 when its software must be updated.
	IndexManagerData uint16 = 0x1F58
)
```

Object indices of CiA 302-3 program download.

## Variables

```go
var ErrPending = errors.New("program: programming in progress")
```

ErrPending is returned by [Handler.Download](#func-handler-download) that goes on programming after it returned: the flash status stays "in progress" until the handler sets it with [Device.SetFlashStatus](#func-device-setflashstatus).

## Functions

### func AddObjects

```go
func AddObjects(d *od.Dictionary, programs int) error
```

AddObjects adds to d, where missing, the program download objects 0x1F50 (DOMAIN, wo), 0x1F51 (UNSIGNED8, rw), 0x1F56 and 0x1F57 (UNSIGNED32, ro) with sub-indices 1..programs.

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	// Handler does the flashing; required.
	Handler Handler
	// Programs is the number of programs (sub-indices); default 1.
	Programs int
	// State, when set, returns the device's NMT state: program control
	// commands are refused (canopen.AbortDeviceState) outside
	// Pre-operational. The node package sets it.
	State func() canopen.NMTState
	// Stopped makes every program start in state Stopped (a bootloader
	// without a running application); by default they start Started.
	Stopped bool
}
```

Config configures a [Device](#type-device).

### type FlashError

```go
type FlashError uint8
```

FlashError is the error code of a flash status (bits 1..7 of 0x1F57). It implements error; FlashOK is "no error".

```go
const (
	FlashOK                FlashError = 0
	FlashNoValidProgram    FlashError = 1
	FlashDataFormatUnknown FlashError = 2
	FlashDataFormatError   FlashError = 3 // data format or CRC error
	FlashNotCleared        FlashError = 4 // flash not cleared before write
	FlashWriteError        FlashError = 5
	FlashAddressError      FlashError = 6 // general address error
	FlashSecured           FlashError = 7 // write access currently forbidden
	FlashUnspecified       FlashError = 63
)
```

Flash status error codes.

#### func (FlashError) Error

```go
func (e FlashError) Error() string
```

Error implements error.

### type FlashStatus

```go
type FlashStatus uint32
```

FlashStatus is the value of the flash status identification 0x1F57: bit 0 programming in progress, bits 1..7 the error code; the other bits are manufacturer-specific.

#### func NewFlashStatus

```go
func NewFlashStatus(inProgress bool, code FlashError) FlashStatus
```

NewFlashStatus returns the status with the in-progress bit and an error code (masked to 7 bits).

#### func (FlashStatus) Code

```go
func (s FlashStatus) Code() FlashError
```

Code returns the error code (bits 1..7).

#### func (FlashStatus) Err

```go
func (s FlashStatus) Err() error
```

Err returns nil when no programming is in progress and the code is FlashOK, the code otherwise (nil while in progress).

#### func (FlashStatus) InProgress

```go
func (s FlashStatus) InProgress() bool
```

InProgress reports bit 0.

### type Handler

```go
type Handler interface {
	// Control executes a command on program n (1..). An error refuses
	// it: an [canopen.AbortCode] is sent as it is, another error as
	// canopen.AbortHardware.
	Control(n uint8, cmd Command) error
	// Download receives the image written to 0x1F50 sub-index n; it is
	// only called while program n is cleared. Returning nil ends
	// programming without error; a [FlashError] (or an error wrapping
	// one) sets that code in the flash status, another error
	// FlashUnspecified, and refuses the SDO download.
	Download(n uint8, data []byte) error
	// Identification returns the application software identification
	// of program n (0x1F56).
	Identification(n uint8) uint32
}
```

Handler does the flashing of a [Device](#type-device). Its methods run on the SDO server's goroutine; a long operation delays the SDO response (and may make the client time out), so a slow flash should return ErrPending from Download and finish in the background.
